name: Unsection
summary: Gallery of website sections from real sites — heroes, pricing, testimonials, navbars and more, browsable by type.
description: Unsection is a section-first design inspiration gallery: sections from live websites are grouped into categories such as hero, feature, testimonial, CTA, footer, navbar, pricing, logo, FAQ, team, contact and portfolio, with search and filters. Free browsing is capped at 30 sections per category and 30 filter results; Pro ($5/month) removes the caps and ads, and a lifetime plan is available. A templates page adds hand-picked Framer and Webflow templates.
contains: website sections from real websites, grouped by section type
free plan: 30 sections per category, 30 filter/search results, 100 saved inspirations
Pro $5/month: unlimited sections, ad-free browsing, weekly updates; lifetime plan available
templates: hand-picked Framer and Webflow templates, free and paid (from $79)
